description: Software Factory inspector for the GitHub Copilot CLI: audits each job when it ends (close, cancel or abandon — from the agent, a chat reply or your terminal), reports on session start, applies your finding replies, and keeps its own controls human-only.

sessionStart.bash: R="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; [ -f "$R/hooks/session-start.js" ] || { echo "[inspector] hook script $R/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped" >&2; exit 0; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[inspector] node is not on PATH; inspector hooks are off (the guard allows everything)" >&2; exit 0; }; exec node "$R/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart
sessionStart.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/session-start.js")) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[inspector] hook script $r/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped"); exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[inspector] node is not on PATH; inspector hooks are off (the guard allows everything)"); exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE
